seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Riverhead, NY 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Riverhead, NY for 2026: Santa at the Railroad Museum and Aquarium, a Polar Express trolley and a drive-through light show.
lede: Riverhead is Long Island's North Fork gateway for Christmas trains, with a Railroad Museum open house, a Polar Express trolley and a drive-through light show in Calverton.
celebrates: Riverhead's holiday season runs on rails and lights. The Railroad Museum of Long Island's Riverhead site holds an Open House with Santa, and the North Fork Trolley in Calverton runs its Polar Express Trolley Ride. The Riverhead Holiday Light Show, now in its ninth season, has a new home at Calverton Airport and runs from November 20 to December 31. The Long Island Aquarium adds a Santa Brunch on December 13 with a photo with Santa and aquarium admission included. Together they give families a free or low cost museum visit, a themed trolley ride and a drive-through light show in the same part of the East End.
lastyear: The Town of Riverhead's calendar lists the 2025 Riverhead Holiday Light Show from November 14 to December 31, 2025, from 5 to 11 pm, at Splish Splash in Calverton. The light show's own pages say it is returning for its ninth season in 2026 at a new Calverton Airport site. We did not find a published 2025 recap for the Railroad Museum or the trolley, so this page relies on the hosts' 2026 pages.
facts: The Railroad Museum of Long Island has sites in Riverhead and Greenport, and its Riverhead site includes a ride on a World's Fair park train, according to our museum page. The North Fork Trolley in Calverton runs a Polar Express themed ride, and the Holiday Light Show's Riverhead edition is in its ninth season. The light show's new address is 901 Burman Boulevard in Calverton.
trains: Riverhead is one of the best Christmas train stops on Long Island. The Railroad Museum of Long Island holds an Open House with Santa in Riverhead, and our museum guide lists its Riverhead and Greenport sites. The North Fork Trolley's Polar Express Trolley Ride in Calverton is one of the licensed New York Polar Express rides, according to our New York Christmas trains guide. Ride the rails to the holidays. The MTA says the Long Island Rail Road's Holiday Lights Train, a locomotive covered in thousands of lights, runs along all electric branches from Monday, November 23 into January, so families who ride the LIRR this season may spot it. Check the LIRR timetable before you plan a train trip to the events on this page, and bring the children to the window to look for the glowing locomotive.

faq: Riverhead pairs train experiences with lights: the Railroad Museum of Long Island's Open House with Santa, the North Fork Trolley's Polar Express ride and the Riverhead Holiday Light Show in Calverton.
Is there a Polar Express ride near Riverhead?
Yes. The North Fork Trolley in Calverton runs a Polar Express Trolley Ride. Reservations are required, and dates and prices are on the trolley's own website.
Where is the Riverhead Holiday Light Show in 2026?
At Calverton Airport, 901 Burman Boulevard in Calverton, from November 20 to December 31, 2026, according to the ticket page. It moved from Splish Splash, where the 2025 show was held.
Can kids meet Santa at the Railroad Museum of Long Island?
Yes. The museum's Riverhead site holds an Open House with Santa, listed on this page with its date and time from the museum.
